responsibility: Declares the polymorphic operator interface used by GCC’s value-range engine to reason about expressions. It defines range_operator and range_operator_float for folding result ranges, back-propagating constraints to operands, and deriving operand/result relations; range_op_handler as the type-dispatch wrapper over irange/frange; helper utilities for boolean and relational ranges; and the operator-table interfaces that map tree codes to concrete range semantics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the polymorphic operator interfaces, handler wrappers, and operator-table access used by ranger to reason about expressions; unlike gcc/range-op.cc it is the interface/abstraction layer, and unlike the plain range files it focuses on operator semantics rather than helper constructors for common ranges.
